        self.cache_dir = cache_dir
        self.session = aiohttp.ClientSession()
        self.chunk_size = 65536  # 64KB chunks

async def _fetch_data(location_ids: List[int], timeframe: Tuple[datetime.datetime, datetime.datetime]):
